purpose: Define the request and response boundary for migrating the temporary capture implementation to the long-running helper bridge.
safety_rules: Do not run capture_start through the temporary one-shot worker when helper provider readiness is false.
Do not mark capture active unless helper response ok=true and generation_token matches the latest Rust/Tauri generation.
Ignore stale helper output when response generation_token does not match the current Rust/Tauri generation.
Do not claim voice capture readiness without target-PC evidence.
Do not claim virtual microphone readiness without target-PC evidence.
Do not route real microphone audio to provider routes until local validation has passed.

migration_state.current_rust_command_guard: start_capture blocks when helper provider readiness is not verified
migration_state.current_temporary_capture_path: present and pending helper bridge routing
migration_state.target_state: capture_start and capture_stop routed through long-running helper bridge with evidence
